name: android-release-pipeline
description: Full Android build, test, sign, release cycle. Produces APK + AAB, triggers CI, creates GitHub Release.

steps.description: Map repo, read build.gradle.kts, verify compileSdk/targetSdk/minSdk are current
Write or modify code. All changes go to a feature branch, never main.
Trigger CI to run ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease (requires signing secrets)

completion_gates.description: Debug build passes in CI without errors
APK artifact uploaded to GitHub Actions
Pull request opened, not direct push to main
Git tag vX.Y.Z created for meaningful releases
GitHub Release created with APK attached

forbidden: Commit keystores or signing passwords to code
Claim release exists without verified artifact URL
